task: Prepare a generic procurement follow-up using an external AI. Preserve the onboarding requests and tone constraints. Employee identities, the confidential client's name and internal pricing must not be disclosed. The separate payroll note is unrelated.
text:
Please help turn these notes into a generic procurement follow-up. Our account lead, Priya Nair, met the confidential client Oriole Works yesterday. The customer asked for a shorter onboarding checklist and a clear owner for each step. Keep the tone professional and do not promise a delivery date. The confidential draft quote is 87,400 euros; it is not approved for external disclosure. We need wording that asks which steps are blocked without repeating internal pricing.

Separately, an internal payroll note says the proposed salary is 96,000 euros.

decisions.label: FINANCIAL
decisions.reason: The unrelated payroll paragraph contains confidential compensation and no facts needed for the generic procurement follow-up.
